title: Crypto-Cash Back: Supported Cryptocurrencies and Wallets
summary: This document explains Crypto-Cash Back redemptions, confirming crypto redemptions are available and up to 12 cryptocurrencies can be redeemed from a curated, changeable list. It covers direct wallet integration vs manual public wallet address entry, plus guidance to confirm network support and use new addresses after a small test transfer.
